channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Opinion | Trump’s anti-Somali rhetoric is repugnant. Minnesota leaders’ silence is worse.
item.description: U.S. Rep. Tom Emmer and House Speaker Lisa Demuth know the truth about their Somali constituents. But in today’s GOP, they are trading courage for political survival.

item.title: Takeaways: Shorthanded Timberwolves top Kings 117-103 for seventh victory in eight games
item.description: The Wolves didn’t have Anthony Edwards or Mike Conley available for the second game in a row, and Rudy Gobert departed in the second half for personal reasons.

item.title: 2025: Minnesota’s year in photos
item.description: Photojournalism capturing the news events that shape Minnesota, and the sports and cultural moments that make us who we are.

item.title: Takeaways: Wild rout Bruins 6-2 as Quinn Hughes scores in successful debut
item.description: Kirill Kaprizov scored twice, and the Wild’s newest star joined in on the scoring with a third-period goal.

item.title: Khue’s Kitchen is the Star Tribune’s 2025 Best New Restaurant
item.description: Eric Pham cooks through fire and family at his St. Paul restaurant, serving up the Twin Cities’ next generation of Vietnamese cuisine.

item.title: Minnesota Valley Transit Authority is proposing route changes, asking riders to weigh in
item.description: Weekend service on two routes would be cut, other routes merged, and a few would see buses running more frequently. Changes would take effect in the spring.

item.title: At nearly half a billion dollars, water park is just the beginning of Mall of America’s transformation
item.description: A portion of profits from the Mystery Cove water park could fund future development near Minnesota’s most famous mall.

item.title: Mike Lindell gives MAGA movement a potent voice in Minnesota governor’s race
item.description: Lindell has strong appeal with the party’s right flank, but other Republicans believe he’d doom their chances of defeating Walz.

item.title: Minneapolis rally demands ICE off post office land; Ilhan Omar says agents pulled over son
item.description: Postal workers say immigration officers staging at post offices poses safety risk for workers and public.

item.title: Takeaways: Another sharp game from J.J. McCarthy lifts Vikings to second win in a row
item.description: QB J.J. McCarthy threw for a career-high 250 yards and two touchdowns and also rushed for a score as the Vikings beat the Cowboys 34-26 on Sunday night.
